<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that break a C‑O bond (6‑8) and form a C‑Cl bond (6‑17). This should retrieve the template that corresponds to the described substitution. Use the inferred product SMILES as the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=Cc1ccc(F)cc1Clc1ccc(CN2CC(F)C2)cc1",
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-17"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
